The Method

Your life runs on
an operating system.

You can change your job, your city, your relationship, your habits. But if the operating system stays the same — the same scenarios keep playing out. Neo Healing works where the programs actually live.

What is Neo Healing

Not the symptom.
The source.

We all recognize this pattern: someone leaves one relationship — and finds themselves in the same one a year later. Leaves a job where they're not valued — and finds another just like it. Decides "I won't react like that anymore" — and reacts exactly like that.

This is not weakness. This is not lack of self-work. This is the nervous system executing its program.

Neo Healing works not with the behavior, not with the symptom — but with what generates those symptoms. With the programs in the nervous system, at the level where they actually live.

The Philosophy

The nervous system
is the operating system.

A person's world is structured like a fractal. The same pattern reproduces itself at every level — in the body, in relationships, in work, in how you respond to stress.

All automatic reactions, all protective strategies, all repeating scenarios — these are not character and not fate. They are programs the nervous system learned as ways to survive or cope.

They serve their function. And that's exactly why they can't simply be "removed" or "resolved" intellectually — they'll flow into another form and continue.

You have to go to the source. And change it there.

Four Principles

How we work.
Why it works.

01
Not the symptom — the source

Stress, illness, destructive patterns — these are not problems to solve. They are signals. Behind each one is a real need the nervous system is trying to meet in the only way it knows. We go there — and meet that need for real.

02
The nervous system directly

In Neo Healing we work with the nervous system directly — through the body, breath, somatics, neuropsychophysiological tools. Not through understanding and awareness. Through real experience in the nervous system.

03
Live contact is primary

No technique replaces real contact between a person and a practitioner. We know the living system we're working with. And we follow it — not the protocol.

04
Change happens now

Not after you "work through your childhood." Not when you're "ready." The nervous system changes through new experience — and that experience can happen right in the session.

The Process

Four steps.
One complete shift.

Find where the pattern lives

Not "why does this happen" — but where in the body and nervous system it exists. What function it serves. What it protects against. What will happen when this changes.

Reach the source

Through bodywork, breathwork, NLP, somatics — we go to where the program was formed and where it is maintained. Not through analysis — through direct experience.

Change the program

Not remove the symptom. But meet the real need — and give the nervous system a new experience. One it can integrate as a new normal.

Integrate

The nervous system changes through repetition. There is time for integration — so the new becomes yours, not just "a result from a course that ended."

The Instruments

One system.
Multiple entry points.

These approaches don't exist separately. In Neo Healing they compose a single instrument — adapted to the specific person in the specific moment.

NLP — Neurolinguistic Programming

Working with beliefs, thought patterns, inner strategies. Changes the program at the level of neural connections.

Neuropsychophysiology

Understanding how the nervous system forms behavior, reactions, defense mechanisms. Gives precision in the work.

Body & Somatic Therapy

Working with the body as the carrier of experience. The body remembers what the mind has already "processed." And the deepest changes happen through the body.

Breathwork

Direct access to the nervous system. Regulation, opening, integration. The breath bypasses the mind — and reaches what the mind protects.

What Makes It Different

Remove the smoke.
Or put out the fire.

Most approaches
—Start with the symptom or behavior
—The body is an add-on to "real" mental work
—Work toward understanding and awareness
—Manage the symptom — learn to cope with it
—Follow a protocol regardless of the person
Neo Healing
✦Starts with the question: what function does this serve?
✦The body is the primary instrument — the nervous system lives there
✦Works through direct experience in the nervous system
✦Meets the real need — so there's nothing left to cope with
✦Follows the living system — not the method

"I started making choices — instead of just following the automatic."

"My relationships changed — and I didn't do anything specific about the relationships."

✦Stress responses change — not because you're controlling yourself, but because the nervous system responds differently
